notes.title: Major update (customized item/component/equipment, robot ships, etc.)
notes.content:
[p]Another major update is coming![/p][p]I’d say the two most important changes are:[/p][list][*][p][b]A brand-new customizable item/component/equipment system.[/b]
Equipment is now made up of components, and each component has its own material. The ore you mine decides the material grade, and that grade (with its properties) defines the component’s stats. On the other side, each piece of equipment has its own “preferences” for different properties—thermal, mechanical, etc.—and these factors together determine its final performance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Automatic mining & survey ships.[/b]
You can now assign a ship to mine a certain ore in a chosen asteroid group, and it will handle the job automatically: mining, storing ore, and refueling. This frees you to think and act more strategically.[/p][/*][/list][p]Other updates include:[/p][list][*][p]Modules can now be disassembled and reassembled.[/p][/*][*][p]A new mining/survey mini-game: it simulates an asteroid cross-section. I’m not sure if it’s “fun,” but at least it feels more engaging than just watching numbers tick up.[/p][/*][*][p]Experimental AI translations (de, es, pt, ja, fr, pl, ko, ru). I can’t guarantee the quality since I don’t speak these languages, so I won’t officially mark them as supported—but I decided to keep them anyway, just in case. Please keep in mind there’s no quality assurance.[/p][/*][*][p]Experimenting some small functions, like you can deploy/retract the solar panel etc.[/p][/*][*][p]More modules/equipment like hangar, cargo etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Continued UI optimization and bug fixes (this work never really ends…).[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you so much for your support—and as always, feedback is more than welcome![/p]

tags.feature: Modules can now be disassembled and reassembled.
A new mining/survey mini-game: it simulates an asteroid cross-section. I’m not sure if it’s “fun,” but at least it feels more engaging than just watching numbers tick up.

Experimental AI translations (de, es, pt, ja, fr, pl, ko, ru). I can’t guarantee the quality since I don’t speak these languages, so I won’t officially mark them as supported—but I decided to keep them anyway, just in case. Please keep in mind there’s no quality assurance.
Experimenting some small functions, like you can deploy/retract the solar panel etc.
More modules/equipment like hangar, cargo etc.

notes.title: Tons of update (weapon system/auto mining ship/tutorial levels/etc.)
notes.content:
This update is available on a separate branch. If you’d like to participate in the test, please click the gear icon in your Steam library, select “Properties”, then go to the “Betas” tab and choose “test - test version” for the Beta Participation to download the update (here for more instructions how to switch branch [url=https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/store/application/branches]link[/url]). If you do not have the access to the playtest, please check my discord channel or QQ group for keys.

[b]Note: This update will break save files from previous versions. Please make sure you’re okay with that before proceeding.[/b]
[b]Note: This update will break save files from previous versions. Please make sure you’re okay with that before proceeding.[/b]
[b]Note: This update will break save files from previous versions. Please make sure you’re okay with that before proceeding.[/b]

Update contents:
[list]
[*]Added tutorial level
[*]Added automated mining ship
[*]Weapon system (testing phase)
[*]Background music system (testing phase)
[*]UX improvements
[*]Bug fixes
[*]Removal of the previous German translation. More text now and I have zero confidence about the AI translations. Will add it back when I find someone I can trust:( 
[*]Some other stuff I honestly don’t quite remember 
[/list]


The weapon and combat systems are still in an experimental stage, and there’s a lot more work to be done — as with many other parts of the game.

Anyway, huge thanks to everyone who’s been testing and participating! If you have any feedback or suggestions, I’d love to hear it!

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed some bugs.
[*] Update UX.
[/list]
This might be the last update for the Playtest version—unless any critical bugs pop up. Huge thanks to everyone who participated and shared invaluable feedback.

I’ll now shift my focus to the demo version. There are three major tasks ahead: (a) Tutorial (b) UX (c) Numerical balancing.

The last two will likely require ongoing iteration, but the most urgent task is (a) Tutorial. I’ve received multiple reports from players—especially those new to this genre—saying the game is hard to understand. So, my plan is to create a series of tutorial campaign levels to address this.

Once again, thank you all and if you have any suggestions, I’d love to hear them.
